description: This file contains utility functions for PDF generation and HTML wrapping within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework, including functions for wrapping HTML tags, preparing strings for PDF output, and formatting currency numbers for PDFs.

methods.name: wrapTD
methods.description: Wraps HTML content in a table row, td, or table tags using options.

methods.name: wrapTR
methods.description: Wraps HTML content in a tr tag using options.

methods.name: wrapTable
methods.description: Wraps HTML content in a table tag using options.

methods.name: wrapB
methods.description: Wraps HTML content in bold tags.

methods.name: wrapI
methods.description: Wraps HTML content in italics tags.

methods.name: wrapTag
methods.description: Wraps HTML content with specified HTML tag and options.

methods.name: prepare_string
methods.description: Prepares a string for PDF printing by decoding HTML entities.

methods.name: format_number_sugarpdf
methods.description: Formats a number as a currency string suitable for SugarPDF, with currency symbol and optional conversions.
